title: Identification of mRNAs as potential blood based biomarekrs for diagnosis and therapeutic monitoring of active tuberculosis
description: To identify potential mRNA candidates for biomarkers for using a transcriptome-based approach, we extracted total RNAs from blood samples of study participants, including a complete set from patients with ATB who underwent a six-month treatment course
